id.description: Optional id attribute applied to the root main element.

titleId.description: Optional id for the h1. Also labels the root element unless ariaLabelledby is provided.

tabIndex.description: Optional tabindex for the root element. Use -1 when the page needs to receive programmatic focus.

ariaLabelledby.description: Optional id reference that labels the root element. Takes precedence over titleId.

title.description: Required page title rendered as an h1.

eyebrow.description: Optional eyebrow text rendered above the page title inside the h1.

content.description: Body content rendered below the title. Supports HTML in Django stories. Ignored if children is provided.

children.description: Body content for React usage. Takes precedence over content if both are provided.
